conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions, building a cash buffer.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% monthly growth by reducing leverage and concentration. It blends broad market exposure with quality tech and a small allocation to leveraged ETFs, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.
